title: The-Garden

milestones.title: Repository charter and complete feature contract
milestones.scope: Preserve the 43-function inventory, user standing instructions, research independence and conditional-government scope in versioned repository documents. Separate product, research, engineering and production acceptance.

milestones.title: Baseline evidence and source-access manifest
milestones.scope: Inventory current Garden policy, CP-017 documents, all four corpus components, charter, exact hashes and access limits. Preserve original sources and distinguish inspected bytes from baseline-reported status.

milestones.title: Canonical security-standard reconciliation
milestones.scope: Retrieve the actual End-To-End-Everywhere standard, pin its revision, compare every required data flow and record differences from this proposed security baseline.

milestones.title: Existing engines and external contract discovery
milestones.scope: Inspect authorized reusable identity, storage, encryption, notification and Engine Room engines before implementing duplicates. Record real APIs, ownership, versions and license constraints.

milestones.title: Threat model and data classification
milestones.scope: Model public, research, sensitive and sealed data flows, attackers, trust boundaries, misuse and retention. Include source poisoning, identity inference, abusive insiders and political targeting.

milestones.title: Public information architecture and design studies
milestones.scope: Design six primary navigation areas and prototype newcomer, descendant-contributor and skeptical-investigator journeys. Establish typography, responsive behavior and historical-image treatment.

milestones.title: Content, expert review and image commissioning plan
milestones.scope: Specify launch texts, exhibits, fiscal/legal review, community consultation and asset review as explicit work with editorial owners and consent boundaries.

milestones.title: Machine-readable plan and release dependency graph
milestones.scope: Commit this PR catalog, JSON schema, dependency DAG, feature crosswalk, release closures and evidence-based progress semantics. Include a local validator and handoff instructions.

milestones.title: Application monorepo and reproducible toolchain
milestones.scope: Scaffold separate public and research apps, shared domain packages and worker services with TypeScript strictness, locked dependencies and local synthetic fixtures. Pin patched Node 24 LTS and compatible stable Next.js at bootstrap.

milestones.title: CI, test harness and supply-chain checks
milestones.scope: Add lint, unit, integration, accessibility, security, build and plan-consistency jobs. Pin external actions by verified commit and scope job permissions minimally.

milestones.title: Branch protection and autonomous merge protocol
milestones.scope: Configure actual repository rulesets, required checks, merge queue when available and safe automated PR chaining. Preserve genuine independent review requirements.

milestones.title: Environment, secret and cost-authorization registry
milestones.scope: Define isolated local, CI, preview, staging and production configuration and required secret names. Inventory existing authorized resources and proposed incremental spending.

milestones.title: Neon foundation and migration roles
milestones.scope: Provision only authorized project-specific Neon environments. Configure runtime, migration and publication roles, TLS connections, pool-aware transactions and extension verification.

milestones.title: First Render staging deployment
milestones.scope: Deploy minimal public/research service shells to authorized Render resources, verify routing, health endpoints, HTTPS and environment isolation.

milestones.title: Object storage and immutable originals
milestones.scope: Configure authorized S3-compatible object storage with separate quarantine, restricted and public-derivative namespaces. Store checksums, encryption metadata and version identifiers.

milestones.title: Transactional jobs, outbox and retries
milestones.scope: Implement durable jobs and transactional outbox with idempotency keys, leases, retry policy, dead-letter queue and cancellation. Avoid an extra paid queue until justified.

milestones.title: Observability with content-safe telemetry
milestones.scope: Add request IDs, metrics, traces, structured redacted logs and error reporting. Separate operational telemetry from reading histories and contributor content.

milestones.title: Staged deployment and database migration pipeline
milestones.scope: Build immutable artifacts, execute serialized expand-contract migrations and verify staging before promotion. Document Render pre-deploy entitlement and safe fallback.

milestones.title: Engine Room adapter and reconciliation contract
milestones.scope: Implement against the discovered Engine Room API only after schema/authentication validation. Produce a local intermediate contract while the actual API is unavailable.

milestones.title: Safe preview environments and cleanup
milestones.scope: Create isolated previews using synthetic or specifically sanitized data, scoped secrets and authorized resource limits. Remove resources after PR closure with explicit retention exceptions.

milestones.title: Identity provider integration and account lifecycle
milestones.scope: Reuse verified identity service or an approved standards-based provider. Implement sign-in, verified account linking, sign-out, suspension and account recovery without bespoke password crypto.

milestones.title: Sessions, passkeys and privileged authentication
milestones.scope: Configure secure session cookies, CSRF protections, session rotation, passkey/MFA support and step-up authentication for sensitive actions.

milestones.title: Roles, membership and researcher onboarding
milestones.scope: Implement organization/workspace membership, role grants, training tasks, expertise claims and accountable reviewer assignments. Community historians need no institutional credential to contribute.

milestones.title: Database row-level security and policy context
milestones.scope: Enforce tenant/workspace and record policies with non-owner runtime roles and transaction-local identity. Test owner bypass and background-worker contexts explicitly.

milestones.title: Unified authorization at every delivery path
milestones.scope: Apply authorization to APIs, search facets, counts, snippets, image tiles, media ranges, exports, notifications and collaboration channels.

milestones.title: Key management and trusted-processing encryption
milestones.scope: Implement approved key-provider adapter, envelope encryption, key separation, rotation and access auditing for server-processed restricted material.

milestones.title: Sealed client-side encryption and recipient keys
milestones.scope: Provide an optional sealed workspace using reviewed client-side cryptographic libraries and explicit recipient-controlled keys. Specify device trust, metadata leakage and unrecoverable-key risks.

milestones.title: Encrypted collaboration and controlled disclosure
milestones.scope: Add encrypted document updates, device/recipient changes and deliberate release of selected sealed material into a named trusted or public workflow.

milestones.title: Consent, purpose and permitted-use enforcement
milestones.scope: Model separate consent for preservation, research, public display, name attribution and promotional endorsement. Track scope, expiry, guardian authority and withdrawal.

milestones.title: Tamper-evident audit and sensitive-action ledger
milestones.scope: Record authorization, review, publication, consent and administrative events in append-only structured audit with integrity verification and redacted payloads.

milestones.title: Authorization abuse and isolation regression suite
milestones.scope: Build reusable property-based and E2E policy tests for every role/data-class combination and all non-HTML retrieval surfaces.

milestones.title: Retention, deletion and legal-hold workflow
milestones.scope: Implement retention classes, review queues, user export/deletion requests, legitimate preservation exceptions and narrowly scoped legal holds. Explain backup and public-copy limits.

milestones.title: Web hardening, dependency defense and secure headers
milestones.scope: Configure CSP, safe HTML rendering, CSRF defense, origin checks, rate limits, dependency scanning and upload-viewer sandboxing. Remove uncontrolled third-party scripts.

milestones.title: Publication and retraction safety kernel
milestones.scope: Require independent checks of research status, rights, consent, privacy, accessibility and release authority before public delivery. Provide deny-first withdrawal across origins and derivatives.

milestones.title: Typed historical entities and reversible relationships
milestones.scope: Model people, polities, peoples, languages, places, institutions, voyages and events with typed relationships, historical names and provenance.

milestones.title: Sources, repositories and archival hierarchy
milestones.scope: Model repositories, collections, series, items, witnesses, editions and digital representations. Preserve conflicting catalog data and source independence links.

milestones.title: Atomic claims, evidence links and placements
milestones.scope: Store atomic source claims, historical interpretations and policy statements separately, with supporting/contradicting evidence and every public placement.

milestones.title: Durable locators and Web Annotation selectors
milestones.scope: Implement edition/page/region/timecode locators, text quotes and positions bound to exact content hashes. Preserve original page labels alongside digital ordinals.

milestones.title: Independent research, rights and publication states
milestones.scope: Implement separate status axes for acquisition, transcription, evidentiary review, rights, consent, accessibility and publication. Record actor and scope of each review.

milestones.title: Structured editorial content and policy versions
milestones.scope: Define typed pages, explanation levels, callouts, definitions, policy provisions and citations. Separate advocacy interpretation from research claims and effective draft versions.

milestones.title: Import quarantine and content inventory service
milestones.scope: Build read-only ingestion manifests, content-type verification, malware/quota checks and quarantine. Record source bytes, transformation lineage and denied access.

milestones.title: Baseline documents and manual-review publication seed
milestones.scope: Register all current research/legislation files and create a small explicitly reviewed public seed with exact provenance and limitations. Preserve restricted originals separately.

milestones.title: Public-only data projection and delivery API
milestones.scope: Create a public serving database/projection using only publication-eligible fields and versions, with separate credentials and revocation checks.

milestones.title: Explicit mapping of all 106 source tables
milestones.scope: Inspect every CP-017 table and map it to raw preservation, normalized destination, legacy snapshot or unresolved recovery status. Define conversion and foreign-key rules.

milestones.title: Idempotent corpus staging importer
milestones.scope: Import exact SQLite and valid export representations into immutable legacy staging, preserving typed cells, NULLs, raw JSON and edition namespaces.

milestones.title: Manuscript structure, citations and comments migration
milestones.scope: Convert DOCX structures, note targets, tables, citations, editorial comments and exact spans without treating comments as source testimony. Preserve edition-local numbering.

milestones.title: Image, rights and derivative migration
milestones.scope: Reconcile actual current-document media and placements with legacy asset tables, carry rights/captions/alt text and distinguish archival images from generated illustrations.

milestones.title: Full migration reconciliation and recovery exceptions
milestones.scope: Produce row, hash, source, note, asset and state reconciliation reports. Preserve CP-016 truncation and CP-011 schema-lineage gaps as open exceptions.

milestones.title: Accessible public shell and navigation
milestones.scope: Build the public site shell with six primary sections, global search entry, footer identity/status and a separate researcher entry point.

milestones.title: Design system and readable content components
milestones.scope: Implement typography, spacing, accessible controls, callouts, cards, long-form reading, citations and distinct source/interpretation labels.

milestones.title: Homepage and first-screen explanation
milestones.scope: Implement the primary definition, public purpose, policy status, optional film, key routes and prominent funding explanation linked to the full caveats.

milestones.title: Layered overview and guided introduction
milestones.scope: Provide brief, guided and detailed explanations with preserved place, definitions and routes to source provisions. Avoid contradictory summaries.

milestones.title: Human-centered story templates
milestones.scope: Build narrated story pages connecting documented lives, institutions, disruption, survival and evidence without inventing scenes or quotes.

milestones.title: Meaning of The Garden and institutional vision
milestones.scope: Explain the metaphor and proposed institutional relationships using accessible text and diagrams with equivalent descriptions.

milestones.title: Image galleries and pose-pair storytelling
milestones.scope: Add paired-image and gallery layouts preserving separate captions, attribution, rights, context and reconstruction labels for each asset. Use the explicitly cleared seed for the first release; full asset migration is added independently under GDN-047.

milestones.title: Introductory film, audio and transcript experience
milestones.scope: Add optional film/audio with captions, transcripts, audio description where needed, playback controls and low-bandwidth alternatives.

milestones.title: Historical exhibits and curated learning paths
milestones.scope: Build thematic exhibits mixing subjects, objects and documents with clear curatorial scope and routes to underlying research.

milestones.title: Contextual glossary and terminology explanations
milestones.scope: Provide accessible inline definitions, pronunciation where licensed and historic/modern term distinctions. Preserve historical offensive terminology with context rather than silently normalizing evidence.

milestones.title: Public visitor routes and reading continuity
milestones.scope: Add optional choose-a-topic routes, breadcrumbs, in-page navigation and local reading position. Avoid demographic targeting or compulsory personas.

milestones.title: About, ownership and proposal status
milestones.scope: Identify the organization, editorial roles, funding disclosures, contact channels and dated legislative status with evidence.

milestones.title: Public FAQ and searchable questions
milestones.scope: Build topic-filtered questions with concise answers, full explanations, dated sources and unresolved-status labels.

milestones.title: Print, lightweight reading and slow-network modes
milestones.scope: Add text-first reading, print styles, optional image suppression and robust low-bandwidth fallbacks. Do not cache restricted research offline.

milestones.title: Multilingual public content and review freshness
milestones.scope: Implement locale-aware routes, directionality, translation provenance, fallback and stale-translation notices.

milestones.title: Public experience acceptance and launch content audit
milestones.scope: Run integrated usability, comprehension, content-source, rights and accessibility checks across newcomer and investigation paths. Create a reproducible acceptance dossier.

milestones.title: Program-stage explorer and decision authority
milestones.scope: Implement enactment-to-census-to-founding-to-compacts-to-enterprises steps and a who-decides view using versioned conditions rather than assumed dates.

milestones.title: Rights and informational eligibility guide
milestones.scope: Explain draft criteria, optional affiliation, privacy, appeals and continuing US citizenship. Provide a non-recording local questionnaire for general information.

milestones.title: Legislative reader with provision anchors
milestones.scope: Render full legislation as accessible HTML with stable section anchors, source file downloads and commentary clearly separated from operative draft text.

milestones.title: Policy version comparison and change notices
milestones.scope: Show side-by-side and inline legislative changes, explanatory change logs and downstream content affected by revisions.

milestones.title: Deterministic funding calculation library
milestones.scope: Implement draft-specific fiscal calculations using decimal/minor-unit arithmetic, versioned assumptions and separate founding, operating, fee, tax and repayment accounts.

milestones.title: Funding center and assumption transparency
milestones.scope: Display cash-flow diagrams, actual-versus-projected distinctions, assumptions, risks, repayment mechanism and downloadable calculation notes.

milestones.title: Fiscal scenario explorer and reproducible exports
milestones.scope: Add editable scenarios for low income, failure, delays, fees and changing costs with baseline comparison and machine-readable exports.

milestones.title: Examples of benefits, choices and failure
milestones.scope: Create labeled hypothetical examples of community budgeting, private investment, reinvestment versus distributions and unsuccessful negotiations.

milestones.title: Objections, alternatives and unresolved analysis
milestones.scope: Provide structured questions, strongest substantive objections, project responses, independent views and comparisons using explicit criteria.

milestones.title: Legal research, authority and ambiguity register
milestones.scope: Link draft provisions to relevant legal analyses and record questions requiring qualified counsel. Track law/source currency without pretending the proposal is enacted.

milestones.title: Public current-documents registry and downloads
milestones.scope: Build the stable latest-work page with current versions, status, prior milestones, checked links and rights-respecting downloads. Preserve existing index redirects.

milestones.title: Policy and fiscal launch integration gate
milestones.scope: Verify policy walkthrough, bill reader, funding model, examples and objections against one consistent draft revision and the public narrative.

milestones.title: Secure resumable source uploads
milestones.scope: Implement chunked uploads, checksums, quotas, pause/resume and clear contributor receipts for allowed file types.

milestones.title: Repository links and bibliographic intake
milestones.scope: Add manual repository records and import of common bibliographic formats, DOI/catalog metadata and citations with conservative matching.

milestones.title: Safe document conversion and derivative workers
milestones.scope: Sandbox text extraction, image tiling and document conversion with resource limits, disabled macros/network and immutable source references.

milestones.title: Page, text and exact-source viewer
milestones.scope: Build zoomable page viewer with original page labels, digital page navigation, side-by-side text and linked evidence regions.

milestones.title: IIIF manifest and interoperability support
milestones.scope: Generate and consume supported IIIF Presentation manifests for eligible images and annotations, maintaining attribution and access controls.

milestones.title: Audio/video archival viewer and time-linked transcripts
milestones.scope: Add media segments, synchronized transcripts, captions and speaker labels with consent-scoped delivery.

milestones.title: Document and witness comparison workspace
milestones.scope: Provide synchronized and independent page/time panes, region matching and explicit alignment hypotheses for multiple witnesses.

milestones.title: Source annotations and evidence capture
milestones.scope: Let researchers annotate image regions, text spans and media segments, attach notes and propose evidence links with visibility controls.

milestones.title: Source acquisition queue and repository requests
milestones.scope: Track scans, permissions, access barriers, repository correspondence, lawful offline research leads and costs without initiating unauthorized transactions.

milestones.title: Source context, reliability and independence reviews
milestones.scope: Add structured reviews of provenance, author position, witness dependence, translation limits, completeness and competing interpretations.

milestones.title: Source citation, rights-aware download and reuse
milestones.scope: Produce citations and authorized source/derivative downloads with complete repository, call-number, edition, locator and license information.

milestones.title: Intake-to-viewer integrated acceptance
milestones.scope: Exercise full source workflow with hostile files, large scans, missing pages, private media, corrected metadata and lost network sessions.

milestones.title: Historical subject pages and dossier navigation
milestones.scope: Build pages for polities, peoples, people, places, institutions, voyages and events with evidence, aliases, scope and uncertainty.

milestones.title: Names, aliases and historical terminology resolution
milestones.scope: Add searchable spelling/transliteration variants, language labels, historical names and explainable suggestions without automatic identity merging.

milestones.title: Public text index and simple search
milestones.scope: Build a public-only full-text index with exact/phrase search, excerpt highlighting, type/status filters and useful no-results guidance.

milestones.title: Research search with permission-first retrieval
milestones.scope: Add separate researcher indexes and policy filters before ranking, faceting, snippets or aggregation. Exclude sealed content from server indexes.

milestones.title: Advanced structured query builder
milestones.scope: Implement an accessible validated query AST for dates, record types, languages, repositories, review states, relations, exact phrases and missing data.

milestones.title: Reproducible queries, saved searches and citations
milestones.scope: Save or share queries against named public snapshots or authorized workspaces, record result counts and offer opt-in change notifications.

milestones.title: Historical geography and uncertainty data layer
milestones.scope: Model sourced geographic assertions, changing names/boundaries and approximate locations without treating modern states as historical polities.

milestones.title: Accessible atlas map and linked list view
milestones.scope: Build progressive-loading maps with synchronized accessible lists, uncertain-boundary styles and optional modern context.

milestones.title: Timelines and temporal investigation
milestones.scope: Display events, source dates and interpretations on navigable timelines with uncertain ranges and linked evidence.

milestones.title: Relationship and movement exploration
milestones.scope: Add relationship and voyage/movement views with source-backed edges, accessible tables and clear hypothesis styling.

milestones.title: Claim evidence drawer and review history
milestones.scope: Expose supporting and contradicting evidence, exact passages, review scope, alternative interpretations and correction history beside public claims.

milestones.title: Reading shelf and private notes
milestones.scope: Add bookmarks, saved passages, private notes and optional cross-device sync. Keep interests and notes out of advocacy profiling.

milestones.title: Public curated collections and share controls
milestones.scope: Let authorized users publish curated record collections with captions, citations and granular sharing after rights/content review.

milestones.title: Dataset and bibliography exports with manifests
milestones.scope: Export rights-permitted query results, citations and structured metadata with schemas, checksums, provenance and snapshot IDs.

milestones.title: Search relevance, language and load evaluation
milestones.scope: Build expert-judged query sets across source languages, exact names, uncertainty and common public questions. Measure quality and performance separately.

milestones.title: Public investigation journey acceptance
milestones.scope: Validate story-to-subject-to-claim-to-source-to-citation journeys across public, researcher and assistive-technology paths.

milestones.title: Diplomatic transcription editor
milestones.scope: Build line/page-bound transcription with uncertain characters, abbreviations, deletions, ditto marks and original orthography. Preserve machine suggestions separately.

milestones.title: Structured registers, tables and row alignment
milestones.scope: Provide cell-level transcription, row boundaries, facing-leaf remarks linkage and competing alignment hypotheses for registers.

milestones.title: Translation and normalized-text layers
milestones.scope: Add distinct diplomatic, normalized and translated layers with language, translator, source-version binding and terminology notes.

milestones.title: Independent second-reading and adjudication queues
milestones.scope: Assign qualified independent reviewers, hide prior readings where useful and preserve disagreements before adjudication.

milestones.title: Entity matching proposals and reversible merge UI
milestones.scope: Provide side-by-side evidence for possible identity matches, duplicate entities and aliases with reject/merge/unmerge workflows.

milestones.title: Atomic claim authoring and evidence linking
milestones.scope: Let researchers split compound assertions, classify claim types and attach supporting/contradicting locators and scoped interpretation.

milestones.title: Peer review, reviewer conflicts and decisions
milestones.scope: Implement review requests, conflict declarations, recommendations, editorial decisions, reasons and appeals with separation of roles.

milestones.title: Shared writing with durable version history
milestones.scope: Implement collaborative rich-text authoring with CRDT or equivalent conflict handling, document versions and typed evidence blocks.

milestones.title: Autosave, interruption recovery and handoff checkpoints
milestones.scope: Add visible save state, retry/backoff, local recovery controls, durable snapshots and exact resume locations for interrupted sessions.

milestones.title: Comments, mentions and review conversations
milestones.scope: Add anchored comments, threads, resolved states and mentions with visibility inherited from the underlying content and explicit editorial purpose.

milestones.title: Research task boards, assignments and dependencies
milestones.scope: Build work queues tied to sources, claims, dossiers, languages and review gates, with task dependencies, ownership and handoff notes.

milestones.title: Notifications, subscriptions and quiet controls
milestones.scope: Add in-app and authorized email notifications, digest preferences, mentions, task changes and opt-in saved-search updates.

milestones.title: Dossier workspace and evidence completeness
milestones.scope: Create structured dossiers for political existence, institutions, chronology, enslavement relationships, disruption, continuity and competing explanations.

milestones.title: Coverage matrix and research-gap analysis
milestones.scope: Track coverage by region, period, language, repository, trade system and evidence type, with explicit searched/not-searched/inaccessible states.

milestones.title: Search logs and citation-chain discovery
milestones.scope: Record source queries, consulted editions, access attempts, backward/forward citations, competing accounts and lawful follow-up leads.

milestones.title: Reopening findings and research dispute handling
milestones.scope: Allow new evidence or credible criticism to reopen claims, freeze affected publication and route independent review without deleting prior decisions.

milestones.title: Researcher workbench, onboarding and training
milestones.scope: Provide one coherent researcher dashboard, training cases, assigned work, source tools and exact resume points without overwhelming new contributors.

milestones.title: Research collaboration integration gate
milestones.scope: Verify intake, transcription, second reading, claim review, dossier work, team handoff and durable save across concurrent users.

milestones.title: Editorial CMS with structured evidence blocks
milestones.scope: Build editor-facing page composition using approved components, source bindings, previews and versioned drafts rather than unrestricted HTML.

milestones.title: Editorial release workflow and independent sign-offs
milestones.scope: Route releases through evidence, editorial, rights, consent and accessibility review, with documented responsibility and immutable release manifests.

milestones.title: Preview, scheduled publication and release rollback
milestones.scope: Implement preview tokens, approved release scheduling, atomic public updates and rollback to a still-eligible release.

milestones.title: Correction dependency graph and impact review
milestones.scope: Track claims into pages, translations, exhibits, models, charts, social assets, downloadable editions and assistant retrieval snapshots.

milestones.title: Public correction notices and superseded editions
milestones.scope: Display material corrections, qualifications and retractions with dates, reasons, precise affected passages and preserved historical editions when lawful.

milestones.title: Image asset registry and provenance interface
milestones.scope: Give editors/reviewers exact original, creator, date, repository ID, rights, image identity, caption, alt text, crops and placements in one asset record.

milestones.title: Licensing requests, restrictions and costs
milestones.scope: Track rights evidence, permission correspondence, allowed uses, territories, credits, expirations and known/unknown fees.

milestones.title: Generated-image reconstruction and historical review
milestones.scope: Add a separate generated-asset workflow with creation provenance, intended illustrative role, historical checks and conspicuous public labels.

milestones.title: Crops, responsive derivatives and alt-text review
milestones.scope: Generate responsive image sizes, safe crops and descriptive alternatives preserving historically relevant details, captions and orientation.

milestones.title: Coordinated web and book edition exports
milestones.scope: Produce coordinated HTML and rights-permitted DOCX/PDF/EPUB/data exports from reviewed content, preserving citations, image licenses and edition identifiers.

milestones.title: Metadata, SEO and safe public discovery
milestones.scope: Add canonical URLs, public sitemaps, descriptive metadata, structured data and safe social previews for eligible content.

milestones.title: Editorial and image release acceptance
milestones.scope: Verify author-to-public release and correction journeys, all asset classes and publication reversal with real editorial roles.

milestones.title: Contributor portal and separate program charter
milestones.scope: Launch an optional contribution program with explicit scope separate from the original research charter, contributor guidance and non-endorsement participation.

milestones.title: Family archive submissions and private receipts
milestones.scope: Provide secure file submission, context forms, attribution preferences, visibility selection and an auditable receipt.

milestones.title: Oral-history consent and narrator review
milestones.scope: Support interview agreements, media permissions, transcript review, narrator corrections, embargoes and distinct research/promotional uses.

milestones.title: Redaction, minors and sensitive contributor material
milestones.scope: Implement redaction review for documents/audio/video, guardian/minor permissions and separate restricted originals with public-safe derivatives.

milestones.title: Withdrawal, embargo and contributor communication
milestones.scope: Let contributors manage permitted visibility, embargo dates, correction requests and withdrawal with clear processing status and limits.

milestones.title: Community advisory groups and public participation
milestones.scope: Publish advisory remit, member permissions, meeting records and consultation channels without treating one person as representative of an entire people.

milestones.title: Community annotations and representation concerns
milestones.scope: Let communities and readers submit contextual annotations, naming concerns and representation challenges linked to records.

milestones.title: Consultation responses and participation transparency
milestones.scope: Publish consultation questions, material submissions where permitted, reasoned responses, unresolved concerns and resulting changes.

milestones.title: Public interviews, conversations and endorsements
milestones.scope: Publish consented public conversations and interviews, separating testimony, reflection, analysis and explicit endorsement.

milestones.title: Moderated public questions and discussions
milestones.scope: Add optional moderated Q&A, reporting, rate limits, appeals and clear separation of discussion from reviewed research.

milestones.title: Research conduct and confidential misconduct reports
milestones.scope: Provide confidential reporting of fabrication, coercion, harassment, conflicts and data misuse, with segregated case access and recusal.

milestones.title: Authorship, contributor credit and conflicts
milestones.scope: Track contribution roles, authorship agreements, affiliations, reviewer credit and declared conflicts across research outputs.

milestones.title: Public appeals and independent dispute review
milestones.scope: Offer accessible routes to challenge historical representation, rights decisions and moderation, with evidence, response windows and impartial reviewer assignment.

milestones.title: Community contribution acceptance and safeguarding gate
milestones.scope: Test contribution, narrator review, representation challenge, withdrawal, moderation and confidential reporting with appropriate reviewers.

milestones.title: Teaching collections and classroom resources
milestones.scope: Build age-appropriate, source-centered teaching collections, activities and teacher guides with content notices and accessible formats.

milestones.title: Source exercises and guided research tutorials
milestones.scope: Provide worked examples of transcription, source criticism, uncertainty, conflicting evidence and citation, using synthetic or cleared training records.

milestones.title: Press center and verified media assets
milestones.scope: Publish current summaries, approved visuals, spokesperson contacts, policy status, corrections and source packs for journalists.

milestones.title: Shareable explainers and accessible social graphics
milestones.scope: Generate reviewed share cards, short explainers and presentations from source-bound content with dates and qualifications.

milestones.title: Events, public conversations and registration
milestones.scope: Add public event pages, capacity-aware registration, calendar exports, access needs, cancellation and optional recording consent.

milestones.title: Volunteer opportunities and matching
milestones.scope: Publish research, translation, outreach and operational volunteer roles with requirements, training and accountable assignment.

milestones.title: Public updates and consented subscriptions
milestones.scope: Offer separate project, research-correction, event and general advocacy subscriptions with preference center and confirmed consent.

milestones.title: Representative lookup and user-controlled civic actions
milestones.scope: Provide optional general-public representative lookup and user-reviewed communications based on accurate district data and current policy materials.

milestones.title: Donations and purpose-separated financial records
milestones.scope: Integrate an authorized payment provider using hosted checkout, separate research/advocacy purposes, receipts, refunds and reconciliation.

milestones.title: Public organizational finances and funding disclosures
milestones.scope: Publish the website/research organization's actual finances and funding sources separately from modeled government-program finances.

milestones.title: Public contact, support and accessibility reporting
milestones.scope: Provide clear contact routes for general questions, corrections, press, accessibility and sensitive concerns, with safe routing and delivery receipts.

milestones.title: Participation and communications acceptance
milestones.scope: Verify education, press, subscriptions, events, volunteering, civic tools, donations and support with realistic consent and failure cases.

milestones.title: Reproducible research datasets and snapshots
milestones.scope: Create immutable analysis snapshots with schemas, source lineage, known gaps and reproducible query/export manifests.

milestones.title: Controlled analysis jobs and notebook execution
milestones.scope: Run authorized analytic code in resource-limited, isolated workers with no arbitrary network access, short-lived inputs and versioned dependencies.

milestones.title: Data cleaning, reconciliation and reproducible transformations
milestones.scope: Provide versioned transformation recipes for dates, names, tabular joins and deduplication proposals with side-by-side raw data.

milestones.title: Evidence-based charts, statistics and map outputs
milestones.scope: Build reproducible analysis-to-chart workflows with accessible tables, denominators, uncertainty and source/exclusion notes.

milestones.title: Computational review and reproducibility gate
milestones.scope: Require another authorized researcher to rerun important computations and inspect assumptions before publishing results.

milestones.title: Assistant retrieval, provider and cost boundary
milestones.scope: Implement an optional assistant gateway over approved public or authorized research material using a verified provider contract, usage limits and data-processing review.

milestones.title: Citation-grounded assistant answer interface
milestones.scope: Add question answering with exact supporting passages, distinctions between quote/inference/uncertainty and links to inspect sources.

milestones.title: Prompt-injection and tool isolation defense
milestones.scope: Treat archival text, annotations and uploads as untrusted data. Restrict assistant tools, egress, cross-record access and mutation capabilities.

milestones.title: Assistant evaluation, bias and abstention
milestones.scope: Build expert-reviewed evaluation sets covering conflicts, missing evidence, source dependence, historical slurs, uncertainty and non-English queries.

milestones.title: Assistant feedback, cost visibility and opt-out
milestones.scope: Add user feedback, answer correction routing, opt-out, usage/cost controls and minimal retained logs.

milestones.title: Bounded research automation proposals
milestones.scope: Let assistants propose transcription drafts, source leads, claim segmentation and task suggestions with human/scholarly review, never silently apply them as accepted evidence.

milestones.title: Analysis and assistant controlled-release gate
milestones.scope: Review reproducibility, provider handling, security, citation accuracy and costs before controlled release of optional analysis/AI capabilities.

milestones.title: Administrative console and least-privilege operations
milestones.scope: Build separate admin views for accounts, roles, imports, queues, publication holds and incidents, with restricted sensitive-case access.

milestones.title: Moderation tools, abuse response and appeals
milestones.scope: Consolidate spam, harassment, copyright concerns, personal-data leaks and abuse reports with triage, evidence, response and appeal.

milestones.title: Public governance, research standards and independence
milestones.scope: Publish editorial standards, advisory remit, authorship, conflicts, appeals, donor separation and correction procedures with version history.

milestones.title: Accurate research progress and coverage dashboards
milestones.scope: Report acquired, read, transcribed, reviewed, rights-cleared and published work separately, with definitions and denominators.

milestones.title: Software plan, PR and production status reporting
milestones.scope: Track planned, implemented, CI-passed, merged, deployed, production-verified and regressed states with GitHub/Render evidence and Engine Room reconciliation.

milestones.title: Data stewardship, rights expiry and access reviews
milestones.scope: Provide administrator queues for expiring licenses, stale permissions, sensitive data reviews, retention actions and storage access checks.

milestones.title: Content-safe analytics and usability measurement
milestones.scope: Measure aggregate task success, search quality, performance and accessibility feedback with minimal collection and no demographic/political targeting.

milestones.title: Operational dashboards and dependency health
milestones.scope: Display service status, queue lag, failed imports, index freshness, broken links, backup age and external integration state.

milestones.title: Financial, cost and resource-capacity controls
milestones.scope: Track website operating costs, authorized budgets, AI usage, storage growth and vendor resource limits separately from program fiscal models.

milestones.title: Governance, administration and status acceptance
milestones.scope: Verify operational controls, governance truthfulness, progress accuracy, moderation and financial separation with an audit-oriented reviewer.

milestones.title: Preservation packages and verifiable backups
milestones.scope: Produce checksummed, size-bounded backups and portable research packages with all manifests, schema, rights, lineage and restore instructions.

milestones.title: Restore drills, key recovery and deletion replay
milestones.scope: Restore authorized backups into isolated environments, recover keys according to mode and reapply withdrawals, legal holds and revocations before serving.

milestones.title: Master current-work index and portable continuation
milestones.scope: Maintain stable project-wide current-work index, per-product latest pointers, downloadable checkpoints and resume instructions after each successful durable save.

milestones.title: Portability and repository-only developer handoff
milestones.scope: Test that a new developer can clone, validate, run synthetic services, understand architecture, locate required credentials and continue work without chat context.

milestones.title: Full accessibility and assistive-technology audit
milestones.scope: Audit complete public and researcher processes against chosen WCAG 2.2 AA scope using automated and manual checks including source tools and authentication.

milestones.title: Performance, capacity and resilience testing
milestones.scope: Test real deployment topology under expected/synthetic growth, simultaneous editing, large files, database sleep/restarts and slow networks.

milestones.title: Backup, outage and incident response playbooks
milestones.scope: Establish incident severity, containment, key compromise response, data-loss recovery, lawful notification review and public status communication.

milestones.title: Independent security assessment and canonical crosswalk closure
milestones.scope: Obtain authorized independent security testing of actual components and reconcile canonical-standard controls, penetration findings and cryptographic boundaries. Assess the enabled core research scope first; sealed, community, AI and government capabilities retain their own independent activation assessments in their feature and release PRs, not an assumed blanket pass.

milestones.title: Full-corpus import and public-clearance release audit
milestones.scope: Reconcile all currently available research artifacts, preserve open historical questions and verify what is eligible for public discovery versus restricted preservation.

milestones.title: Public launch deployment and smoke gate
milestones.scope: Launch the reviewed public explanation and document library on authorized production resources with verified DNS/HTTPS, backups and visible status. Verify seed backup/restore, minimal live monitoring and safe metadata here; the full-corpus backup and monitoring suites follow without blocking this bounded release.

milestones.title: Research beta deployment and real cohort verification
milestones.scope: Release researcher tools to an authorized cohort, import permitted material and verify actual uploads, collaboration, review, publication and withdrawal online.

milestones.title: Complete public/research capability release
milestones.scope: Verify the full non-government feature inventory across providers, documentation, consent, performance and production behavior. Record any intentionally disabled optional capability.

milestones.title: Production monitoring and release regression controls
milestones.scope: Configure authorized health checks, dependency alerts, security updates, restore exercises and regression-triggered status changes as application operations.

milestones.title: Final non-government acceptance and operational handoff
milestones.scope: Perform final feature inventory, source preservation, security, accessibility, live deployment and repository-only handoff review. Establish ongoing ownership and unresolved research backlog.

milestones.title: Legal authority and governmental product activation contract
milestones.scope: After actual enactment and authorization, retrieve operative law/rules and establish governmental operator, mandate, privacy authority, funding and separate repository contracts.

milestones.title: Government repository, tenancy and assurance boundary
milestones.scope: Establish separate governmental application/services with authorized identity, isolated data stores/keys, procurement and accessibility/security requirements.

milestones.title: Official roster publication and administrative record
milestones.scope: Implement official roster versions, evidence, agency decisions, public notice and distinction from independent scholarly dossiers.

milestones.title: Statutory comments, petitions and reasoned responses
milestones.scope: Support legally specified comment windows, correction petitions, accessible filing, docketing and reasoned decisions with required retention.

milestones.title: Enrollment evidence submission and private casework
milestones.scope: Build authorized identity/evidence submission, case assignment and secure family-record handling under adopted standards.

milestones.title: Duplicate enrollment, minors and affiliation changes
milestones.scope: Implement legally authorized duplicate detection with privacy-preserving identifiers, guardian/minor processes and allowed founding-period affiliation corrections.

milestones.title: Eligibility decisions, notices and impartial appeals
milestones.scope: Support human-authorized decisions, reasons, evidence requests, impartial appeals and final status under adopted rules.

milestones.title: Nation certification and public instruments
milestones.scope: Accept authorized founding instruments and publish certification status, constitutions, public laws and budgets with verified signatures and redaction.

milestones.title: Official opportunity register and equal access
milestones.scope: Publish verified governmental offers, districts, conditions, existing rights, readiness requirements and deadlines for every eligible nation, including non-Assembly participants.

milestones.title: Sealed preferences and auditable closing process
milestones.scope: Implement externally reviewed sealed submissions, immutable receipts, authorized common deadlines, controlled key custody and auditable opening ceremony.

milestones.title: Voluntary negotiation and compact workspaces
milestones.scope: Provide authorized negotiation records, draft agreements, conflicts, invitations and voluntary joint proposals without giving the Assembly power to impose outcomes.

milestones.title: Government public finance and compact reporting
milestones.scope: Publish authorized audited budgets, enterprise reporting, fee/repayment calculations and compact compliance with confidential fields segregated.

milestones.title: Nation portals and government service boundaries
milestones.scope: Provide linked public portals for laws, budgets, notices and service directories, with clear service owners and separate governance.

milestones.title: Government legal, security and production acceptance
milestones.scope: Conduct formal authorized acceptance of every activated governmental function, including independent security, legal process, accessibility, operations and disaster recovery.

scopeNote: Exact 210 work package titles and scopes recovered from plan/plan.json; the last 14 are contingent governmental scope, not activated powers or deployed features. PR links come only from existing reviewed historical mappings.
